mapper.sql: p.id, p.tracking_no, p.courier_company, p.owner_id, p.station_id, p.shelf_id, p.pickup_code, p.status, p.remark, p.inbound_time, p.outbound_time, p.return_reason, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.real_name AS owner_name, u.username AS owner_username, u.phone AS owner_phone, s.name AS station_name, sh.code AS shelf_code, pa.id AS active_auth_id, gu.real_name AS active_auth_grantee

FROM parcel p JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.owner_id JOIN station s ON s.id = p.station_id LEFT JOIN shelf sh ON sh.id = p.shelf_id LEFT JOIN proxy_auth pa ON pa.parcel_id = p.id AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN sys_user gu ON gu.id = pa.grantee_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parcel (tracking_no, courier_company, owner_id, station_id, shelf_id, pickup_code, status, remark, inbound_time) VALUES (#{trackingNo}, #{courierCompany}, #{ownerId}, #{stationId}, #{shelfId}, #{pickupCode}, #{status}, #{remark}, now())

where.if: AND (p.tracking_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.real_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.username ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.pickup_code = #{keyword})

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM parcel p JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.owner_id
mapper.update: UPDATE parcel SET status = 'RETURNED', return_reason = #{reason}, outbound_time = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('IN_STOCK', 'OVERDUE')
UPDATE parcel SET status = 'PICKED_UP', outbound_time = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('IN_STOCK', 'OVERDUE')
UPDATE parcel SET shelf_id = #{shelfId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: UPDATE parcel SET status = 'OVERDUE', updated_at = now() WHERE status = 'IN_STOCK' AND inbound_time < #{before} RETURNING *

SELECT p.* FROM parcel p WHERE p.status IN ('IN_STOCK', 'OVERDUE') AND p.inbound_time < #{before} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification n WHERE n.parcel_id = p.id AND n.type = 'REMIND' AND n.channel = 'IN_APP' AND n.sent_at > now() - (#{remindGapHours} || ' hours')::interval ) ORDER BY p.inbound_time LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM parcel WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT count(*) FROM parcel WHERE inbound_time >= date_trunc('day', now())
SELECT count(*) FROM parcel WHERE status = 'PICKED_UP' AND outbound_time >= date_trunc('day', now())

SELECT to_char(d.day, 'MM-DD') AS day, COALESCE(i.cnt, 0) AS inbound, COALESCE(o.cnt, 0) AS outbound FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', now()) - (#{days} - 1) * interval '1 day', date_trunc('day', now()), interval '1 day') AS d(day) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('day', inbound_time) AS day, count(*) AS cnt FROM parcel GROUP BY 1 ) i ON i.day = d.day LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('day', outbound_time) AS day, count(*) AS cnt FROM parcel WHERE status = 'PICKED_UP' GROUP BY 1 ) o ON o.day = d.day ORDER BY d.day
SELECT status AS name, count(*) AS value FROM parcel GROUP BY status

WITH grid AS ( SELECT d.dow, h.hr FROM generate_series(0, 6) AS d(dow) CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 23) AS h(hr) ), src AS ( SELECT ((EXTRACT(DOW FROM inbound_time)::int + 6) % 7) AS dow, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM inbound_time)::int AS hr, 1 AS inb, 0 AS outb FROM parcel WHERE inbound_time >= now() - #{weeks} * interval '1 week' UNION ALL SELECT ((EXTRACT(DOW FROM outbound_time)::int + 6) % 7), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM outbound_time)::int, 0, 1 FROM parcel WHERE outbound_time IS NOT NULL AND status = 'PICKED_UP' AND outbound_time >= now() - #{weeks} * interval '1 week' ) SELECT g.dow AS "dow", g.hr AS "hour", COALESCE(sum(s.inb), 0) AS "inbound", COALESCE(sum(s.outb), 0) AS "outbound" FROM grid g LEFT JOIN src s ON s.dow = g.dow AND s.hr = g.hr GROUP BY g.dow, g.hr ORDER BY g.dow, g.hr
SELECT courier_company AS name, count(*) AS value FROM parcel GROUP BY courier_company ORDER BY value DESC
